Mahany Pery

Download PDF

Height 5'9'' // 175 CM

Shoe 6

New York +
Portfolio

Mahany Pery is a Brazilian-born model who began her career at age 16 in Rio de Janeiro. She made her runway debut for 3.1 Philip Lim in the Spring 2018 season and has gone on to walk for Balmain, Dolce & Gabbana, Monse, Sally LaPointe, and Nina Ricci, to name a few. Part of Pery’s allure lies in her ability to elevate everything she touches, whether she’s fully-clad in denim for a Madewell editorial or walking the Chanel runway. Editors and advertisers alike are drawn to her sublime yet warm appeal, for being somehow both aspirational and approachable, while also refined yet radiant. Pery has appeared in ad campaigns for Chanel Cruise, Fenty Beauty, Saks, and Swarovski and graced the covers of Vogue Mexico, Kinfolk, and more.
